# How much federal R&D credit could your team claim?

> Free R&D tax credit calculator for startups and small companies. Paste staff wages and time on research, compare the regular and simplified credit, see the Section 280C cost and the payroll-tax offset. Illustrative; nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
